name: Sunstrider Isle: a troll can take the isle's zone quests (#4061)
contract: The Travel Permit 977028 (AscensionTravelPermit.cpp) sends any Horde character up to level 8 to Sunstrider Isle
(530, 10349.6 -6357.29 33.4026), beside Magistrix Erona 15278. Her zone quests carried the stock blood elf mask
512, while the isle's own 8547, 9704, 9705 and 8350 take every Horde race (690). Expected: a level 3 troll
standing there sees Erona's available marker, can take Reclaiming Sunstrider Isle 8325 and, once it is
rewarded, can take its follow-up Unfortunate Measures 8326. The troll talks to its own Erona, since the lane

steps.label: Magistrix Erona offers the troll a quest
The troll can take Reclaiming Sunstrider Isle
Fixture: the mana wyrms are slain
The troll can take Unfortunate Measures
